//: The DECLARED cascade-event ledger read by check-propagation-reaches.
These four are not 'some events'. They are the entire generic change-propagation
protocol of the estate: DependencyResolver computes which elements a change
transitively affects (via SemanticGraph) and announces the result on exactly these
four names. Everything else that propagates in PRYZM is bespoke, per-pair wiring
(DoorDependencyTracker, WallRebuildCoordinator, RoomTopologyObserver...).
EV-03 §0.7 and BIM30-EVOLUTION-AUDIT §550 measured both halves independently and
found BOTH missing, which is why this gate asserts both:
* zero listeners anywhere in the estate, and
* no prevState on the emitter, because DependencyResolver subscribes to
storeEventBus (StoreChangeEvent = {elementId, elementType, operation, timestamp})
rather than to the stores, and the §STEP7 third argument never reaches it.
Either half alone is INSUFFICIENT and asserting only one would be theatre:
- listeners without prevState  -> subscribers can only invalidate wholesale;
the diff-based work (adjacent-wall discovery, _isPropertyOnlyChange fast paths)
they exist to do is unreachable. That is precisely the ADR-057 defect (W2-2).
- prevState without listeners  -> a perfectly-shaped event nobody receives.
declaredFindings is a NAMED, SHRINK-ONLY ledger. Each entry is '<event>:<arm>'.
A name that stops appearing must LEAVE this list in the same commit that fixes it,
or the gate exits 3 STALE LEDGER — debt that has been paid must not stay on the books.

events.name: pryzm-dep-cascade
events.why: general-purpose cascade fan-out; carries { tasks, triggerElementId, operation }

events.name: pryzm-room-reval
events.why: a room's bounding wall changed (boundedBy / adjacentTo)

events.name: pryzm-hosted-reval
events.why: a wall hosting an opening changed (hosts / hostedBy)
